name: block-secret-store-reads
description: Best-effort guard against an agent reading credentials from the shell: cat, cp, tar, source or < on ~/.ssh (not .pub), ~/.aws, ~/.npmrc, agent CLI dirs, browser DBs, wallets, .env, *.tfstate; interpreter one-liners naming them; token printers (gh auth token, aws sts); curl, wget or iwr to cloud metadata credential paths (169.254.169.254, 169.254.170.2, GCE). Asks on env dumps. Misses: scripts, unresolved variables, xargs lists, $(...) results, metadata reached by DNS name, proxy or SDK. [Best-effort in Devin by a PreToolUse hook shipped with the plugin's hooks.json (witnessed blocking on Devin CLI 3000.11.3 (local session), Windows, 2026-10-08). In the vendor's own words, plugin hooks are 'currently best effort and fail open -- if a hook fails to load or run, the session continues without it -- so don't rely on them for crucial guardrails yet', documented for local Devin sessions (the CLI and Devin Desktop) only. The hook command expands $DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT, an environment variable the vendor documents hook commands receive; whether that expansion happens inside a hooks.json command string is documented, not witnessed here. The hook needs git and a Python 3.11+ on PATH. Repo-wide git-hook and CI coverage still needs `chock sync`.]
